newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Petronas, Shell hand over joint facilties.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Petronas, Shell hand over joint facilties.

text.p: Petronas Dagangan Bhd and Shell Timur handed over the management and operation of their jointly-owned facilities in Tawau, Sabah to PS Terminal Sdn Bhd, Petronas said in a statement.

PS Terminal, the joint venture company formed recently to manage, operate and maintain the facilities, was set up under a Joint Facilities Agreement signed between Petronas Dagangan and Shell Timur, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, in March 1995.

The joint facilities are made up of an existing bulk storage depot, which is being expanded, and a new liquified petroleum gas bottling plant, still under construction and nearing completion, the statement issued on Tuesday said.

Petronas said PS Terminal will expand the scope of co-operation between Petronas Dagangan -- the listed retail arm of Malaysia's state oil company -- and Shell to include operation and maintenance of the facilities apart from being its joint owner and developer.
PS Terminal is equally-owned by Petronas Dagangan and Shell. It has an authorised share capital of 100,000 ringgit divided into 100,000 shares with a par value of one ringgit each, Petronas said.
